about:
RDI Foods, LLC is a food consulting firm based in Raleigh, North Carolina. Founded in June 2002 by Dr. Richard "Rody" Hawkins after 17 years at ConAgra Foods and Philip Morris (Kraft Foods), the company was created as a resource to help food companies solve problems, create value, and improve margins. The principals—Dr. Hawkins, Larry Chandler (food process and project management), Steve Klawiter (packaging systems), and Dr. Sarid Shefet (innovative food processing)—collectively hold over 85 years of industry experience and 28 patents.

The firm specializes in food product research, development, and plant implementation. It designs and coordinates innovative solutions for established food companies, including new product and process development for domestic and international markets, cross-functional team leadership for production launches, raw material cost reduction, process efficiency improvements, and shelf-life evaluation. RDI Foods also develops and implements Safe Quality Food (SQF) programs, and has expertise in military product development and specification writing under a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the U.S. Army Soldier Systems Command in Natick, Massachusetts.

Clients span the food industry, from commercial manufacturers of shelf-stable and preserved foods to the U.S. military. The company has worked with the U.S. Army since 1993 on shelf-stable sandwiches, earning an Excellence in Research Award. It also partners with food companies on joint ventures, sharing profits from co-developed products. Examples include pepperoni and pizza production consulting, and projects for five food companies in a 12-month period.

RDI Foods distinguishes itself through its principals' deep technical expertise in shelf-stable foods, processing, and packaging, combined with a consulting model that moves beyond advice to hands-on implementation in production environments. The firm's SQF programs have been recognized as industry models, and its military R&D track record demonstrates capability in high-stakes, regulated product development.
